explanation: Built a site-routed Blog/CMS from the empty Rust scaffold with typed commands and bounded generated named operations for feed, moderation, slug lookup, and detail. The sealed real-HTTP run completed a generated command and immediately fenced its generated detail-page read at the returned durable commit; exact response identities were verified by the generated client. Boundary, exact-package, formatting, lint, compile, and test checks passed. The rating leaves room for a richer application-level test suite beyond the successful sealed end-to-end workflow.
